comparison.q: How is Jejak different from bit.ly or Linktree?
comparison.a: Jejak is all-in-one: one app to shorten links (with a custom slug), build a named link-in-bio profile page, and view a dashboard of clicks per link: plus QR codes and indie print themes. So you don't need to juggle several services at once.

free.a: Yes. The dashboard, public profile page, custom slug, and click counts are all free at this stage: no card required. If paid features arrive later, we'll announce it clearly first, not quietly.

customSlug.q: Can I use my own name / custom slug?
customSlug.a: Yes. That's actually Jejak's core feature: you set the short code yourself (for example jejak.app/r/your-name) so it's easy to remember & from the dashboard you can see click counts for each link. Not a random string.

analytics.q: Do analytics / click counts work right away?
analytics.a: Right away. Every link has a click count shown on the dashboard and on the profile page: honest numbers matching real clicks, not fakes to look busy. Plus a per-link QR code that scans too.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.paragraph1: By using Jejak, you agree to use this service reasonably: creating legitimate links, not abusing the shortener feature, and not uploading content that breaks the law.
terms.paragraph2: This page is still a placeholder: the official Terms & Conditions text is being drafted and will be published here before the official launch. If you have any questions, contact us through the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.paragraph1: We only collect the data needed to run Jejak: the account you register, and visit statistics for your links (clicks, referrer, time) for analytics in the dashboard.
privacy.paragraph2: This page is still a placeholder: the full privacy policy: including data retention, cookies, and your rights over your data: is being drafted and will be published here before the official launch.
